body:
That McDonald’s fry cook is me
| | | | | [](https://eub669hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001tsgZAHpnCLE_br3I12zP9RG25Ki-vAKzOBvLkabdsOQ4uGQn7s5PkUSR3AwPMFN2rN0H5Wivi2xqaHOucrBIwWwElzNKD0EhnB_3gLhbqiLYAac4UktII46IOkJ06peLR_aUBYnHa-1F5EGxiEKyU-gpRQ_f85K4OYlmP0kWzsSLU-ZYN62RD5JcWQvZJDZMdgqb74goIp6ABHJBRJp9nxnBDWTleS9Q&c=wc2FdsczYNJjx7UG847VIQwTChnKGudl7yB2s433uePsEUhl-LU_Nw==&ch=239Xrb87Pasgf9_sRWmTZvxdc-icCG8nhuZPQthMUDMij6pDRV2gMQ==)
---
|
The Guardian just published a profile of our campaign.
Here's the headline: "Can a former fry cook flip a key district for Democrats?"
---
| [](https://eub669hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001tsgZAHpnCLE_br3I12zP9RG25Ki-vAKzOBvLkabdsOQ4uGQn7s5PkUSR3AwPMFN2rN0H5Wivi2xqaHOucrBIwWwElzNKD0EhnB_3gLhbqiLYAac4UktII46IOkJ06peLR_aUBYnHa-1F5EGxiEKyU-gpRQ_f85K4OYlmP0kWzsSLU-ZYN62RD5JcWQvZJDZMdgqb74goIp6ABHJBRJp9n2erpc2FNhrH&c=wc2FdsczYNJjx7UG847VIQwTChnKGudl7yB2s433uePsEUhl-LU_Nw==&ch=239Xrb87Pasgf9_sRWmTZvxdc-icCG8nhuZPQthMUDMij6pDRV2gMQ==)
---
That fry cook is me.
And my story has led me to this moment:
When I was 10 years old, I filled out my first food stamp and Medicaid form. My mom was an immigrant, raising me on her own, working hard every single day. By the time I graduated high school, I had already put in two years behind a McDonald's register.
I sold my own blood plasma so many times to help cover the bills that it left a permanent scar on my arm.
I worked through community college, then an associate's degree, then a bachelor's degree, then a master's at Johns Hopkins, then Yale Law School -- working multiple jobs the entire way.
---
| [](https://eub669hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001tsgZAHpnCLE_br3I12zP9RG25Ki-vAKzOBvLkabdsOQ4uGQn7s5PkUSR3AwPMFN2rN0H5Wivi2xqaHOucrBIwWwElzNKD0EhnB_3gLhbqiLYAac4UktII46IOkJ06peLR_aUBYnHa-1F5EGxiEKyU-gpRQ_f85K4OYlmP0kWzsSLU-ZYN62RD5JcWQvZJDZMdgqb74goIp6ABHJBRJp9nwJkvAtXqsZi&c=wc2FdsczYNJjx7UG847VIQwTChnKGudl7yB2s433uePsEUhl-LU_Nw==&ch=239Xrb87Pasgf9_sRWmTZvxdc-icCG8nhuZPQthMUDMij6pDRV2gMQ==)
---
Today I'm a state legislator, and I'm running for Congress in what's rated one of the closest, most competitive House races in the entire country. [Before I continue, I have to ask: can you chip in $5 to my campaign to help me flip this House seat? ](https://eub669hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001tsgZAHpnCLE_br3I12zP9RG25Ki-vAKzOBvLkabdsOQ4uGQn7s5PkUSR3AwPMFN2Vp-iqpBt-tDLyF3XltuwiUxdWyoJ0MSE0doy-BbqzJ4UGRoIx0PmwLoVj4GmDo-1OJTcHQ6IEGcWg6AnZX0jSLmuEw2IipKdp0gQ0x-W80FarANPlsRnCyZfu017rtBPKMwBtnSGYvV0qS8i9J_S1LqAKjfKIgJ0bA2IWmbaXItceH3OgAIIeA==&c=wc2FdsczYNJjx7UG847VIQwTChnKGudl7yB2s433uePsEUhl-LU_Nw==&ch=239Xrb87Pasgf9_sRWmTZvxdc-icCG8nhuZPQthMUDMij6pDRV2gMQ==)
---
| [](https://eub669hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001tsgZAHpnCLE_br3I12zP9RG25Ki-vAKzOBvLkabdsOQ4uGQn7s5PkUSR3AwPMFN2rN0H5Wivi2xqaHOucrBIwWwElzNKD0EhnB_3gLhbqiLYAac4UktII46IOkJ06peLR_aUBYnHa-1F5EGxiEKyU-gpRQ_f85K4OYlmP0kWzsSLU-ZYN62RD5JcWQvZJDZMdgqb74goIp6ABHJBRJp9nxLvuB091fGC&c=wc2FdsczYNJjx7UG847VIQwTChnKGudl7yB2s433uePsEUhl-LU_Nw==&ch=239Xrb87Pasgf9_sRWmTZvxdc-icCG8nhuZPQthMUDMij6pDRV2gMQ==)
---
The Guardian's reporters spent real time with me to understand why the affordability crisis isn't a talking point for me. It's my whole life.
Here's what I told them: "Sometimes you hear politicians talk about the affordability crisis, like they just read it in a memo somewhere. But for me, it's deeply personal."

The RINOs in Texas are still throwing a fit over losing to Ken Paxton.
| | | |
---
|
---
Fellow Conservative: Texas is about to decide the fate of the Senate majority — and if we lose it, we won't just lose a seat. We'll hand Democrats their first statewide win in Texas since 1994, and the earthquake will be felt by Americans across the country. First, let's be clear about how we got here. The Republican establishment in DC spent over $150 million — the most expensive Senate primary in American history — trying to stop Ken Paxton from becoming the nominee. _They lost._ Paxton defeated Sen. John Cornyn by nearly 30 points. But the damage was done, and now Democrat James Talarico is within striking distance of flipping the seat. You'd think Cornyn would be all-in to stop him from turning Texas blue. Nope. Instead, he's trashing Paxton as lazy and a poor campaigner, while telling reporters the party shouldn't spend another dime on his race because of limited resources. That's rich. **Even worse, Cornyn is working with former President George W. Bush to pull money out of Texas to fund moderate Senate candidates in other states — many of whom are far bigger underdogs than Paxton.** With friends like these, who needs enemies?

Even worse, Cornyn is working with former President George W. Bush to pull money out of Texas to fund moderate Senate candidates in other states — many of whom are far bigger underdogs than Paxton. With friends like these, who needs enemies? Ken Paxton has spent over a decade as Texas Attorney General doing what the GOP establishment only talks about. He sued the Biden administration more than any other AG in the country — on the border, on illegal mandates, on federal overreach — and won. While career politicians in Washington cut deals, Paxton has been on the front lines of the fight against the open-borders agenda. President Trump didn't endorse him as an afterthought — he called Paxton a "true MAGA warrior" because Paxton has earned it. That's exactly why the establishment tried to kill his campaign before it started and why they're throwing a temper tantrum now. A real fighter in the Senate threatens the comfortable do-nothing environment they've built in DC. They'd rather have an empty suit who plays along with their empty promises and endless excuses than a conservative who delivers. Make no mistake: John Cornyn and the GOP establishment are working against Paxton because they want Texas to lose. They need it to lose, so they can point at the wreckage and say, "See? Only RINOs can win." It's a self-fulfilling prophecy. They know the game. Give conservative voters a choice between a Democrat and a RINO, and we'll hold our nose and vote RINO. But give us a choice between a Democrat and a real conservative, and the establishment would rather watch us lose than let us win on our own terms. It was never about winning a majority; it was about maintaining their control over the party. Senate Conservatives Fund exists for exactly this fight — to back conservative candidates in the races the party committees have already written off, when the committees would rather protect their own than protect the country. You can donate to SCF to support our independent efforts to elect Ken Paxton, and you can contribute directly to his campaign. It's the best way to help conservatives win in Texas. We are running out of time, so please take action before it's too late. to help Ken Paxton finish this fight — and send the establishment a message they won't forget: their days of picking our nominees for us are over. The future of the Republican Party belongs to conservatives, and we're sending John Cornyn's replacement to Washington. ---
| | Earlier this month, Congressman Kean held his fourth Senior of Distinction event since taking office in Washington. He celebrated 24 seniors that hailed from all six counties in the district and highlighted the great work they have done in their respective communities for decades. _ “The people we recognize today represent what is best about our communities. They have spent years giving their time, sharing their experience, helping their neighbors, and strengthening their hometowns. So much of what makes a community strong comes from people who simply choose, day after day, to show up for others. It is a privilege to recognize these extraordinary New Jerseyans and to thank them for the example they continue to set for all of us.”_ **_-_ Congressman Tom Kean Jr.**

Vote by mail ballots have officially been mailed, so make sure to check your mailbox and return it NOW! There are more details below about how you can return your VBM, but if you are interested in signing up for voting by mail, you can do so . This Sunday is also DEBATE NIGHT in NJ-07! You can find out how to watch the debate by clicking this . We’ll keep sharing important dates, updates, and reminders as we head into the final stretch. Thank you for being a part of the team! | | | | | | | | | | | ✅ Kean Holds Annual Seniors of Distinction ✅ | | Earlier this month, Congressman Kean held his fourth Senior of Distinction event since taking office in Washington. He celebrated 24 seniors that hailed from all six counties in the district and highlighted the great work they have done in their respective communities for decades. “The people we recognize today represent what is best about our communities. They have spent years giving their time, sharing their experience, helping their neighbors, and strengthening their hometowns. So much of what makes a community strong comes from people who simply choose, day after day, to show up for others. It is a privilege to recognize these extraordinary New Jerseyans and to thank them for the example they continue to set for all of us.” - Congressman Tom Kean Jr. | | | | | | | Field Update | | | | | | | It was another busy few weeks on the trail for Tom, with stops at the Mendham Labor Day Parade and the John Basilone Memorial Parade in Raritan Borough. He also joined a packed canvassing launch at Union County GOP Headquarters and stopped by the Stirling Elks Carnival for Special Needs Children, connecting with families and members of the community. It was a full few weeks across the district and a great reminder of just how much is happening in our communities! Our field team is full steam ahead with a little over 40 days until the Election. This past week, we have had door knocking teams in Bedminster, Bernards Township, Bridgewater, Clark, Clinton Township, Flemington, Hopatcong, Mount Arlington, Mount Olive, Netcong, New Providence, Phillipsburg, Raritan Borough, Sparta, Summit, Tewksbury, Union Township, Washington Township, Westfield, andWhite Township. Peter,
Every one of the red-to-blue races we’re taking on is proof of something Republicans don’t want you to believe: _their grip on power isn’t permanent._
With the right resources behind leaders who refuse to be bought by corporate interests or mega donors, and a message that truly connects with working people’s priorities, we can flip these seats.
**That's exactly why our Red-to-Blue Fund exists — to power bold, young candidates competing in the most critical districts across the country.**
**[Pitch in $5 now to power our Red-to-Blue Fund and fuel the final stretch for our endorsed candidates fighting to flip these seats blue.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260923_1_r2b.avUK2S&refcode=em20260923-4049&amount=5&t=2&akid=4049%2E587540%2EoVPsnV)**

In a must-win election year, these are the races that will break GOP supermajorities and flip state legislatures. Here are a few of the candidates leading that fight:
⭐️ **Laalitya Acharya** for Ohio, HD-56 ⭐️
⭐️ **Ken McCool** for North Carolina, HD-105 ⭐️
⭐️ **Tim Hayes** for Pennsylvania, HD-143 ⭐️
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260923_1_r2b.avUK2S&refcode=em20260923-4049&amount=5&t=4&akid=4049%2E587540%2EoVPsnV)
**Laalitya Acharya** founded the Warren County Young Dems, and fought back when Ohio Republicans tried to make it harder for constituents to pass ballot measures like the reproductive rights amendment. She’s running for Ohio’s statehouse to fully fund public schools, and expand healthcare access.
Her Republican opponent, Adam Mathews, is endorsed by JD Vance, chairs the board of a network of anti-abortion “crisis pregnancy centers,” and has argued against raising the minimum wage. At 22 years old, Laalitya is already outraising her incumbent challenger 3-to-1 without taking a dime of corporate money — but she needs your support right now to keep up her momentum and make sure this seat flips blue.
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260923_1_r2b.avUK2S&amount=5&refcode=em20260923-4049&t=5&akid=4049%2E587540%2EoVPsnV)**
**Ken McCool** made history when he became one of the youngest elected officials in North Carolina’s history at 21 years old. Since then, he’s served as Mayor Pro Tem, expanding affordable housing options, securing the largest park investment in Matthews' town history, and helping recruit the Hendrick Advanced Manufacturing Campus, bringing in high-paying jobs and new industry to the region. In Raleigh, he’ll fight to lower costs for working families, protect reproductive rights, and make sure Mecklenburg County gets its fair share of investment in education, transit, and public safety.
Ken is taking on Tricia Cotham, a Democrat turned Republican who cast the deciding vote to restrict abortion access in North Carolina and won her seat by just 206 votes in 2024. District 105 is competitive, but winnable — and winning this race is critical to making sure we’re able to protect the Democratic governor’s veto power.
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260923_1_r2b.avUK2S&amount=5&refcode=em20260923-4049&t=6&akid=4049%2E587540%2EoVPsnV)**
**Tim Hayes** made history at 21 as the youngest person elected in Bucks County and the first openly LGBTQ+ member of Dublin Borough Council, then he helped flip the council blue. He now works at Conservation Voters of Pennsylvania, where he’s secured millions for land conservation, clean energy, sustainable farming, and has been sounding the alarm on AI data centers’ encroachment on local communities.
In Harrisburg, he’ll fight to build out Pennsylvania’s clean energy economy, hold corporations accountable, and make life more affordable for working families in Bucks County. Tim is taking on a GOP incumbent in a seat Democrats nearly flipped in 2024. This is our chance to finish the job. Tim has already proven he can flip a district — this one’s next.
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260923_1_r2b.avUK2S&amount=5&refcode=em20260923-4049&t=7&akid=4049%2E587540%2EoVPsnV)**
Flipping these red seats blue is absolutely critical for state legislative power across Ohio, North Carolina, and Pennsylvania. Because the state legislature is where some of our most important fights are being decided: reproductive rights, who draws the maps for the 2028 elections, funding for public schools, combatting voter suppression, passing anti-gun violence legislation, medicaid funding. That’s why I’m asking for your support today — we need grassroots supporters like you showing up to have these leaders’ backs and end the GOP’s grip on power in Ohio, North Carolina, and Pennsylvania.

Here are a few of the candidates leading that fight: ⭐️ Laalitya Acharya for Ohio, HD-56 ⭐️ ⭐️ Ken McCool for North Carolina, HD-105 ⭐️ ⭐️ Tim Hayes for Pennsylvania, HD-143 ⭐️ Laalitya Acharya founded the Warren County Young Dems, and fought back when Ohio Republicans tried to make it harder for constituents to pass ballot measures like the reproductive rights amendment. She’s running for Ohio’s statehouse to fully fund public schools, and expand healthcare access. Her Republican opponent, Adam Mathews, is endorsed by JD Vance, chairs the board of a network of anti-abortion “crisis pregnancy centers,” and has argued against raising the minimum wage. At 22 years old, Laalitya is already outraising her incumbent challenger 3-to-1 without taking a dime of corporate money — but she needs your support right now to keep up her momentum and make sure this seat flips blue. Ken McCool made history when he became one of the youngest elected officials in North Carolina’s history at 21 years old. Since then, he’s served as Mayor Pro Tem, expanding affordable housing options, securing the largest park investment in Matthews' town history, and helping recruit the Hendrick Advanced Manufacturing Campus, bringing in high-paying jobs and new industry to the region. In Raleigh, he’ll fight to lower costs for working families, protect reproductive rights, and make sure Mecklenburg County gets its fair share of investment in education, transit, and public safety. Ken is taking on Tricia Cotham, a Democrat turned Republican who cast the deciding vote to restrict abortion access in North Carolina and won her seat by just 206 votes in 2024. District 105 is competitive, but winnable — and winning this race is critical to making sure we’re able to protect the Democratic governor’s veto power. Tim Hayes made history at 21 as the youngest person elected in Bucks County and the first openly LGBTQ+ member of Dublin Borough Council, then he helped flip the council blue. He now works at Conservation Voters of Pennsylvania, where he’s secured millions for land conservation, clean energy, sustainable farming, and has been sounding the alarm on AI data centers’ encroachment on local communities. In Harrisburg, he’ll fight to build out Pennsylvania’s clean energy economy, hold corporations accountable, and make life more affordable for working families in Bucks County. Tim is taking on a GOP incumbent in a seat Democrats nearly flipped in 2024. This is our chance to finish the job. Tim has already proven he can flip a district — this one’s next. Flipping these red seats blue is absolutely critical for state legislative power across Ohio, North Carolina, and Pennsylvania. Because the state legislature is where some of our most important fights are being decided: reproductive rights, who draws the maps for the 2028 elections, funding for public schools, combatting voter suppression, passing anti-gun violence legislation, medicaid funding. That’s why I’m asking for your support today — we need grassroots supporters like you showing up to have these leaders’ backs and end the GOP’s grip on power in Ohio, North Carolina, and Pennsylvania. Thank you, David Hogg

Then the war started.
| ★ After-Action Report / CAPT M. BOUCHARD / MI-10

Peter, In June of last year, four months into my deployment, I was in Kuwait, finally on my way home on leave. Then war broke out between Israel and Iran. Our base in Iraq had already faced more than 100 credible threat streams from ISIS, Iranian-backed militias, and Iran itself. I knew exactly what was coming for the Americans still there. So I withdrew my leave.

SPONSOR A VOTER REGISTRATION ACTIVIST

I've spent over a decade of my life registering new Republican voters — too many to count — because I've learned one unshakable truth: nothing wins elections like having a bigger pool of voters than the Democrats.

Not a mailer. Not a TV ad nobody watches. Not a "we'll match your gift" gimmick some consultant cooked up to squeeze one more dollar out of you.

Just a voter registration activist with a clipboard and the determination to make sure every single Republican they meet is registered to vote and casts a ballot.

With less than 50 days until Election Day, my organization Early Vote Action is staffing up in the swing states and critical races that will decide control of Congress. Just this week I'm deploying at least nine more voter registration staffers across four of the most competitive House districts in the country. Now I need to hire two more — and I'll send in even more backup if you can find it.

Every dollar you give goes straight into the ground game: more staff on the streets, more Republicans registered, more Patriots at the polls on Election Day.

SPONSOR A VOTER REGISTRATION ACTIVIST

Here's the math that keeps me up at night — in the good way: races keep coming down to a few thousand votes, sometimes a few hundred. One motivated activist can have dozens of meaningful conversations in a single hour. Multiply that by the hundreds of activists we can deploy with your help, and that's a grassroots operation that swings elections.

Patriot, I'm asking you to sponsor a voter registration activist for 1hr. Just $25. No membership, no match, just grassroots action.

I'm not asking you to fund another ad you'll scroll past. I'm asking you to put a real person on a real doorstep, today, for one hour, for $25.

Let's get serious.

God bless you,

Scott Presler

Robust, multimodal transit can offer Coloradans the **freedom** to reach more of our beautiful state, including our parks, museums, and wild places.

Here's the question I hear everywhere right now: if Democrats take the majority back, what are you actually going to do with it?
It's the right question. And in Part 2 of our conversation last week, Adrian Boafo gives an answer I think people need to listen to.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..3AHm8vj3WrMSgoi1mi07cpduSs-1_NwsgLQdCweaHoI?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=217055924)
Short version: oversight alone isn't enough. We have to pass things.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/d67a7248-9ea1-4536-a6ae-142cb47fb5a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Yes, oversight. Yes, investigations. Yes, hold people accountable. But if we get the gavels back and we don't pass minimum wage, don't fix housing, don't touch healthcare, the people who showed up for us are going to ask what the point was. They'll be right to ask. Adrian put it plain: we get the majority and do nothing for people, we're going to have a real problem in 2028. Not a messaging problem. A trust problem.
He also gets into AI. Not the usual "let's commission a study" move Congress always makes when it doesn't want to act. He's saying regulate it now. Because we already lived the internet story, we didn't act then, and here we are. The founder of Anthropic said humanity could be gone by end of decade. That's not a fringe position anymore. Congress is still scheduling hearings.
On crypto: 65 million Americans hold crypto assets. The President made $4 billion off a meme coin. His family. Money from people who want to undo everything we built. You think that doesn't need oversight? I don't know what to tell you.
Part 3 drops tomorrow. Subscribe below so you don't miss it. It's the best one.
-Harry

It's the right question. And in Part 2 of our conversation last week, Adrian Boafo gives an answer I think people need to listen to. Short version: oversight alone isn't enough. We have to pass things. Yes, oversight. Yes, investigations. Yes, hold people accountable. But if we get the gavels back and we don't pass minimum wage, don't fix housing, don't touch healthcare, the people who showed up for us are going to ask what the point was. They'll be right to ask. Adrian put it plain: we get the majority and do nothing for people, we're going to have a real problem in 2028. Not a messaging problem. A trust problem. He also gets into AI. Not the usual "let's commission a study" move Congress always makes when it doesn't want to act. He's saying regulate it now. Because we already lived the internet story, we didn't act then, and here we are. The founder of Anthropic said humanity could be gone by end of decade. That's not a fringe position anymore. Congress is still scheduling hearings. On crypto: 65 million Americans hold crypto assets. The President made $4 billion off a meme coin. His family. # PRESS RELEASE

**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
September 23, 2026

**CONTACT**
Todd Cheewing
Todd@Ascent-Strategic.com

**XI VAN FLEET ENDORSES LILY TANG WILLIAMS FOR CONGRESS**

WEARE, N.H. — Xi Van Fleet, author and outspoken critic of communism, endorsed Lily Tang Williams for Congress, citing their shared experience growing up in Chengdu, China, during Mao’s Cultural Revolution. The endorsement comes as President Trump hosts Chinese President Xi Jinping in Washington today for a historic state visit. “My friend Lily Tang Williams and I are both from Chengdu, China. We each lived through the horrors of communism and Mao’s Cultural Revolution,” said Van Fleet. “Today, however, we see the same evils we thought we had escaped being embraced and promoted by the _radical_ Democrats.” “But Lily isn’t standing by silently—she’s sounding the alarm. She’s running for Congress in New Hampshire and she needs all the support she can get to win.” Williams welcomed the endorsement: “Xi and I escaped communism and came to America because we understood how precious freedom is,” said Williams. “We recognize the warning signs because we have lived through them. I’m running for Congress to defend the freedoms that made America the greatest nation on Earth—and I’m honored to have Xi standing with me in that fight.”
**About Lily Tang Williams**
Born in China just before Mao’s Cultural Revolution to working-class parents, Lily Tang Williams immigrated to the United States with nothing and built a life as an entrepreneur, educator, and community leader in Weare, NH. A living embodiment of the American Dream, she brings a uniquely powerful perspective to the fight for freedom and limited government.

In 2024, Williams won the Republican nomination and captured 47% of the general election vote against current incumbent Maggie Goodlander — coming closer than any Republican has in more than a decade to flipping NH-02. She is back and running stronger than ever in 2026.

Peter,
When looking at this election, the conventional wisdom is that no one can beat Greg Abbott. So no one was stepping up to run against him.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260923_1_outspent.hJL63C&refcode=em20260923-2201&amount=5&t=1&akid=2201%2E299639%2Eyfzgkx)

And now we’re closer than ever, with poll after poll showing us closing the gap and pulling ahead of Abbott and over 170,000 real people fighting for change in Texas. But we still need to finish the job — and I can’t do it without your help.
Right now, Abbott has outspent us more than 10-to-1 because he can feel the governorship slipping away. He knows his 12 years in power are up, and he’s using everything at his disposal to disempower our movement with attack ads.
I can’t stress this enough — we don’t need to match his millions. We just need enough resources to continue to reach voters on the ground and make sure that my message is heard above Abbott’s lies.

body:
They are not buying a verdict. They are buying my calendar, my
attention, and my team's nerve.

They are not buying a verdict. They are buying my calendar, my
attention, and my team's nerve.

View in Web Browser
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e724911/UaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvQ2pLZGpIdFZoTg/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA5MjM/LbmNsd0VCSTBhUg/qP2hpZHM9bmNBQmxGUXJBczA2ZW9sc10/garPSRw/s9i0e9a453c

[O'Keefe Media Group]
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

Dear Patriot,

[Donation Page]
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.
I want to explain something about the lawsuits, because almost
everybody misunderstands what they are actually for.

THEY ARE NOT TRYING TO WIN.

Look at the record. AFT V. O'KEEFE. KOERBER V. O'KEEFE, all the way to
the California Supreme Court. TETER V. O'KEEFE. DEMOCRACY PARTNERS V.
O'KEEFE, in the D.C. Circuit Court of Appeals.

EVERY SINGLE PERSON WHO HAS SUED ME HAS LOST.

And the most recent one was not decided on a technicality. A federal
appeals court in Washington threw out the jury verdict against me and
held that UNDERCOVER REPORTING LIKE OURS IS PROTECTED BY THE FIRST
AMENDMENT. For fifteen years I was told that what I do is not
legitimate journalism. A federal court has now concluded otherwise, in
writing.

The people filing these cases can read that record as easily as you
can. THEY KNOW EXACTLY HOW IT ENDS. THEY FILE ANYWAY.

So ask the obvious question. If you already know you are going to
lose, what are you actually purchasing?

YOU ARE PURCHASING MY CALENDAR, AND I WANT TO SHOW YOU THE RECEIPT.
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

KEEP THE CAMERAS ROLLING — CHIP IN $35
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.
There are three things a lawsuit buys the person who files it, and a
verdict is not one of them.

THE FIRST IS DISTRACTION.

A deposition consumes an entire day. Discovery consumes weeks. There
are filings, motions, calls with counsel, documents to locate, and
every one of them lands on my desk rather than somebody else's.

A day spent in a conference room answering questions about footage I
shot three years ago is a day I am not looking at what is in front of
us right now. THEY CANNOT STOP THE NEXT INVESTIGATION. THEY CAN
ABSOLUTELY MAKE ME LATE FOR IT.

THE SECOND IS DEMORALIZATION, and this one is aimed at my people, not
at me.

Within days of that federal appeals ruling, ANOTHER LAWSUIT WAS FILED
AGAINST ONE OF MY UNDERCOVER JOURNALISTS. Not against me. Against a
young reporter who did the field work. Somebody who never attended law
school, has no legal department, and has no corporation standing
behind them.

Understand the message that sends to every talented young person
considering this work. WE CAN REACH YOU PERSONALLY. WE CAN PUT YOUR
NAME ON A DOCKET. WE CAN MAKE THE NEXT FIVE YEARS OF YOUR LIFE
EXPENSIVE AND FRIGHTENING.

THE THIRD IS TIME, which is the only thing in this business you
genuinely cannot replace. Appeals take years. Defenses take years. And
they are counting on the arithmetic that a reporter who spends five
years defending old work is a reporter who is no longer producing new
work.

THAT IS THE ENTIRE STRATEGY, AND IT IS WORKING ON EXACTLY ONE FRONT.
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

YES — FUND THE INVESTIGATIONS THEY WANT STOPPED
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.
Now I have to be very clear with you, because I do not want a single
dollar landing in the wrong place.

I AM NOT WRITING TO YOU ABOUT LEGAL BILLS.

Our legal defense is funded separately. That is handled, my attorneys
are outstanding, and it is not what I am asking you for today. PLEASE
DO NOT SEND THIS GIFT THINKING IT PAYS A LAWYER, BECAUSE IT DOES NOT.

Here is what the lawfare actually costs, and it never shows up on an
invoice.

IT COSTS INVESTIGATIONS THAT NEVER HAPPEN.

The tip that came in during a week I was buried in discovery. The
state I could not put a team into because I was in a deposition on the
day the decision had to be made. The story that was live for eleven
days and then closed, because the person willing to talk stopped being
willing.

NOBODY EVER SEES THOSE. THERE IS NO VIDEO OF THE INVESTIGATION YOU DID
NOT FUND. That is precisely why this strategy is attractive to the
people using it. THE DAMAGE IS INVISIBLE, AND I AM THE ONLY ONE WHO
CAN TELL YOU IT HAPPENED.
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

CHIP IN $35 AND PUT IT IN THE FIELD
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.
So let me tell you how this actually gets beaten, because it is
simpler than it sounds.

There is exactly one measurement of whether their strategy worked. DID
O'KEEFE MEDIA GROUP PUBLISH MORE THIS YEAR, OR LESS?

That is the scoreboard. It is the only scoreboard. AND NOT ONE LINE OF
IT IS DECIDED IN A COURTROOM.

It is decided by whether there is money to put a team on an airplane.
Right now I have TWO TEAMS WORKING UNDERCOVER IN TWO DIFFERENT STATES.
I cannot tell you where and I cannot tell you what they have. I can
tell you that they exist because somebody funded them, and that
keeping both of them out there costs real money every single day.

YOUR GIFT DOES NOT GO TO A LAWYER. IT GETS ON A PLANE.

That is the answer to all of this. Not a better legal argument. MORE
CAMERAS, IN MORE PLACES, MORE OFTEN. The lawsuits are designed to make
me smaller, and the only response that has ever worked is to get
louder.

AMERICA STARTS VOTING SEPTEMBER 19, when the first federal ballots go
out. I intend for my people to be standing in the right locations when
that happens, not sitting in a conference room reading a court docket.

YOU FUND THE MISSION. MY TEAM TAKES THE RISK. YOU SEE THE RESULT WITH
YOUR OWN EYES.

There is nobody else writing this check. IT HAS ALWAYS BEEN YOU.

RUSH YOUR GIFT NOW
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.
Thank you for all that you do, and please . . . stay tuned.

In Truth,[James O'Keefe]
James O'Keefe
Founder, O'Keefe Media Group

P.S. Four lawsuits, four defeats for the people who filed them, and a
federal appeals court that just described our work as protected
journalism. They are not trying to beat me. They are trying to keep me
busy until I stop filming. THE ONLY THING THAT HAS EVER ANSWERED THAT
IS ANOTHER CAMERA IN ANOTHER STATE, AND THAT IS WHAT YOUR GIFT BUYS.
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

RUSH YOUR GIFT NOW
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

[O'Keefe Media Group]
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

_You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you only want our most important email updates,[click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/108?t=2&akid=3195%2E259176%2EUMoAoP) If you'd like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/109?t=3&akid=3195%2E259176%2EUMoAoP)_

Peter, For years, South Floridians have been told that Maria Elvira Salazar’s seat was untouchable. But now, a shocking new poll shows our race is _dead even._

In a district that Salazar won by over _20 points_ in 2024, this is a huge deal. It's proof our campaign has what it takes to win, and that South Florida voters are fed up with MAGA chaos. [](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/16958?source=SL_EM_FR_2026.09.23_ERodriguez-Heat_B3_F1_S1_C1_180AC-360DON&t=4&akid=3195%2E259176%2EUMoAoP) **While this poll is great news for our campaign, it also means our race is about to get a lot harder.**

Folks,
I first started working with Roy longer ago than I care to remember, so I've seen him run tough races, including in 2016 when he won by just 10,000 votes. But in all my years as Roy's pollster, I've never seen him in a race like this.
**[I spend all day looking at the numbers. That 's my job. So believe me when I tell you: This race is closer than you think it is. Roy needs your support, so if you're able, please chip in a donation to him today.](https://substack.com/redirect/4e401d65-41c5-4a42-8aeb-be72d6b5b235?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/4e401d65-41c5-4a42-8aeb-be72d6b5b235?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
If you're still with me, let me tell you why.
**North Carolina is a notoriously hard and expensive state to campaign in.** It's big, and its voters are spread out all over the state. That means that there's no efficient way for the campaign to buy ads, which means that those ads get more and more expensive.
**Republicans have all the money in the world to make up the difference**. Between super PACs like Trump's and the RNC's $125 million war chest, the GOP has every dollar they need to take over the North Carolina airwaves and drown out Roy's message. The campaign is fighting back, but it's getting harder and harder.
**This race is already tightening.** Since Trump's super PAC started buying ads in North Carolina, Roy's lead has been cut in half. We've always known this could happen, with less than two months until Election Day, it's more important than ever that we fight back and win this race.
But beating this GOP super PAC money is going to take all of us, so Roy needs your support TODAY. **[Please, will you chip in $5 or whatever you can to help me fight back and protect voting across North Carolina?](https://substack.com/redirect/4e401d65-41c5-4a42-8aeb-be72d6b5b235?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

John Anzalone

I call them "Five-Minute Hot Spots"--our nightly ritual. Since my children were old enough, we've walked through the house gathering what the day has left behind: shoes, cups, books--the small evidence of lives being lived.
For five minutes, we restore order--not to erase the evidence of living, but to honor it. This simple discipline matters far beyond our own walls: the practice of cultivating clarity within our communities, our commons, and our republic is an essential act of stewardship.

**Pause.
Breathe.
Look Deeper.

Refuel.**
**Welcome to Sweet Ground.

clean_body: We’ve set a goal to raise $500,000 by the end of September to unlock $1.5 million for EMILYs List women | = Hey Peter, It's just over a month until Election Day. Our team has been watching EMILYs List women gain momentum all across the U.S. this past year — but right now, many of these races are too close for comfort. Republicans know this — it’s why they’re asking their megadonors to spend tens of millions in races up and down the ballot to try and drown our women out. We can’t let that happen. That’s why we’re launching an end-of-quarter 3X Match Fund that runs from today until September 30. Our goal is to raise $500,000 and unlock a full $1.5 million for EMILYs List women. This is a REAL match backed by the EMILYs List community and a REAL chance to triple your impact. And this fund is especially important because it’s our last end-of-quarter deadline before Election Day. = | = Match campaigns like this one are only possible when the moment demands it — and when we know that our EMILYs List community will show up. This is crunch time, Peter. Our ability to take back majorities in the U.S. House, U.S. Senate, and state legislatures across the country will be decided by the voters who are just now tuning in to the midterms. And last week, Donald Trump’s personal super PAC reserved over $100 million in advertising to try and sway undecided voters toward Republicans. This has always been the Republican game plan: counting on millions in dark money to hide their record and smear our EMILYs List women. But while they’ve spent the cycle courting special interests, our candidates have shown up each and every day for their communities. EMILYs List women have laid the groundwork for real, grassroots change all cycle. Right now, they’re finalizing their budgets and GOTV plans to make sure they have what they need to win on Election Day. subject: My thoughts on what’s happening in New Hampshire

body:
Chris Pappas is in a close race — and Republicans are coming for this seat.
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260923_1.fuUEBK&refcode=em20260923-1&t=1&akid=9088%2E582294%2ECpushb)
Hi, it’s Kentucky Governor Andy Beshear.
There’s a lot of noise in an election year — I know that better than most. **But let me be very clear: The Senate race in New Hampshire could decide the direction of this country.**
Chris Pappas is running in a close race. It’s been rated a Toss Up. And with Donald Trump in the White House, the stakes couldn’t be higher.
**[That’s why I’m asking you to donate right now to help Chris Pappas win.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260923_1.fuUEBK&refcode=em20260923-1&t=2&akid=9088%2E582294%2ECpushb)**
The first year of this second Trump Administration has seen chaos, division, and dangerous rollbacks of basic freedoms. That’s why it’s so important that we elect leaders like Chris Pappas — leaders who know how to bring people together, deliver real results, and who will never forget who they’re fighting for.
Chris’s opponent is a former U.S. Senator with national name recognition and the backing of national Republicans and their deep-pocketed super PACs. Republicans believe they can flip this seat and block any chance that we have of checking Trump’s power in Washington.
But I believe in Chris — and I believe we can win.
Chris understands that leadership isn’t about grabbing headlines or scoring political points. It’s about showing up, listening, and doing the hard work to deliver for working families. He’s done that in Congress, and I know he’ll bring that same spirit of public service to the Senate.
Kentucky and New Hampshire may look different, but our people want the same things: good jobs, strong public schools, access to health care, and a better future we can build together. That’s what Chris Pappas is fighting for. **_But he can’t do it alone._**
**[If you’re with me — and ready to stop Trump and his allies from flipping this critical seat — contribute now to help Chris Pappas win.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260923_1.fuUEBK&refcode=em20260923-1&t=3&akid=9088%2E582294%2ECpushb)**

Thank you for standing up and stepping in when it counts.
Let’s get Chris across the finish line.
Thank you,
Andy Beshear
Governor of Kentucky

| | **_Meet Russell:_** Born and raised in Surfside Beach, SC, Congressman Russell Fry is the proud and homegrown Representative for South Carolina’s 7th Congressional District. Growing up in a cinder block home with no heating or air conditioning, Russell learned at an early age that hard work and perseverance pave the only true path to the American Dream. He watched his parents work day in and day out to make ends meet. And the values they instilled in him during his upbringing led Russell to self-fund both his undergraduate education at the University of South Carolina, and later his law studies at the Charleston School of Law. At Charleston, Russell served as the President of the Student Bar Association and even helped the school achieve its American Bar Association accreditation. He went on to practice law in the Grand Strand area for over a decade before entering the political arena to serve in the South Carolina House of Representatives for State House District 106 (Horry County). During his seven-year tenure in the SC House, Russell fought to safeguard Constitutional liberties, lower taxes, and put the best interests of South Carolina families above all else. He climbed the ranks to become Chief Majority Whip, and also chaired the House Opioid Prevention Study Committee. Under Russell’s leadership, 18 policy initiatives to combat the opioid crisis were signed into law. Since the first day he stepped foot in Washington, Russell has strived to shake up the corrupt status quo and deliver real change for the American people. He believes adamantly that so long as the American people stand united, we can keep the American Dream alive for every citizen of our great nation. Russell is a dedicated husband to his wife, Bronwen, and a loving father to his son, James. The family lives in Murrells Inlet with their chocolate lab, Jasper.

Dear Peter,

_" I rang the doorbell, and a lady answered."_

That's how Grace's story starts.

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=57c2f7b092a845338aac9e2d3549cf46&_e=xCl87rqskzVHTI62rFK_epGFdaJFpUHnebg9PI8T5QqI5IJZSM_hn4JLOBsR4PZxO8KpBts0PcTO7f0k284yVGl2KZXOyqALEC_qdFnwExEjFnq27KOqGWDugE7b0pBajRk6s0IZ_HZBh7jVPpRI_8b0PHUKMBQ0dKdJ-Ma2YnZ5poTQs9hHuJRVy_tgDDRlIiHERmIxPyN8oJj-TLOQkne7F5YjH4Lli9V1xUrN-_bmwTSdpZujA3mFf0Mh_0V2ofbllaJO24Jm-7CyUcqQAFfjPEo2Tsaq5uR_VhtOpCjX9pDEF4D2ZTMyTC30LhBJXnmXEdglqcC4epQgee0wUAi6kRN61fPLEPbVNmZlmJUi1JlbjeDNqapmnfrb2wyUDbPNoAIGmw_-7IUGNsfsa6vCIH-8A5YSnrp-04AMwJ2sd0CqUlQRqSRkl0f-77mBotECEovG-4_twhtDmlLYP2xd_bCVNb1Mvu291L25udhlkS4cSaWvqD26zWNYEAuCMYis8FJRUgZ2oy2EMXImlTElgb9aVUzFK7SIa9Sm2a3Zojxjw8-NE-8bbxsFRwFeUsAL6L-Uk82o0PxHml8_jALAcHsHgaXxUxJxRO4RAXImU9RnEbWJ-G5UIqg_blEy)

She introduced herself. Told the woman she was volunteering to protect preborn babies. Asked politely if she could count on her vote.

The woman said "no, thank you." Grace said have a good day and turned to leave.

**That 's when someone screamed from inside the house. A second woman ran out the door - she chased Grace down the driveway, shoved her, and hit her in the head with both fists.**

As Grace tried to run away and reached the end of the driveway, the woman threw a dinner roll that hit her in the face - **and kept following her down the street, screaming that she hoped Grace would be run over by a car.**

Grace filed a police report. The woman was arrested and charged.

My name is Kristan Hawkins, and I'm the President of Students for Life Action. You can think of us as the grassroots arm of the Pro-Life Movement.

Peter, this is just one story from one of Students for Life Action's door-to-door canvassers during the last midterm election.

I've told every one of our canvassers to prepare for anything over the next two months.

I wish I could tell you Grace's story was a one-off. It isn't. Doors get slammed. Voices get raised. Sometimes it gets violent.

And yet our canvassers keep walking up the next driveway because they know if the Abortion Lobby seizes power in November, it will be a death sentence to millions more innocent preborn babies.

**_[Peter, will you please prayerfully consider sending a Care Package to one of our door-to-door canvassers heading into the field this fall](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=57c2f7b092a845338aac9e2d3549cf46&_e=xCl87rqskzVHTI62rFK_epGFdaJFpUHnebg9PI8T5QqI5IJZSM_hn4JLOBsR4PZxO8KpBts0PcTO7f0k284yVGl2KZXOyqALEC_qdFnwExEjFnq27KOqGWDugE7b0pBajRk6s0IZ_HZBh7jVPpRI_8b0PHUKMBQ0dKdJ-Ma2YnZWHbuExq879ZNR9m4EnfjyBFVqcwAITnhGuS8rjE55Q3EexAQT0U-ILT-rBdX8BaCo_5oN-zlUSKiwi1mvl6r6l7hbvq1kCmqiy5z_-yu-vLQPXELi7C8WqSwkXYlqaXGgs2eKyzwddbjckR_PouxnichToEOjWcHVOqGen436h8AOPG5b7QMsah9ON-xA5UFcLdOHGhXSLg4EJ8sy-8z-sQxKramYLGMWiSTS4LKHJ7v1Wslh728OKUQ2R61B9hFwKjqL_MBWdI8XbWfc19M4AbO7oTLQDnK2PI1TJtaiIQ_pnM5MScROrUbktNF6BWr4YqgZC7yZTUnanWOw9ytSvX5IFiGc2Vrz9jDwvfldNVke6yp3_yPJi4Iz2m0AjetCaBN7RKkSTTCwhUjXmFvuqt-Mcz-BOVRJ45k3iqbCC_jy4DByvIvR8smkLemnf517l191MkdqRj-KzJZnk7R98TpksnIIJ6dILDpnlSR5Qw%3D%3D)_**?

These young women and men will be walking for hours in scorching heat. Knowing pro-lifers like you have their backs will help keep them going.

Of course, I could tell our door-knockers to go home.

I could focus on running expensive TV ads instead.

But studies show that face-to-face conversations move voters more than any TV ad, mailer, or text ever could - and the effect doesn't disappear after one election.

**Voters who talk to one of our students in person are more likely to show up and vote pro-life again in the _next_ election cycle, too.**

_And, it only costs us about $3 for every door we knock._

Not only that, but we'll be deploying teams of pro-life activists to blanket church parking lots with flyers exposing the records of pro-abortion politicians in key districts every Sunday in September and October.

This is the on-the-ground grassroots campaigning that's needed to turn out every pro-life voter.

Last cycle, this approach worked.

***** In Oklahoma,** our student canvassers knocked 633 doors, made 26,931 phone calls, and sent 26,078 texts exposing two pro-abortion senators who killed our Chemical Abortion Pill Trafficking Bill - and voters threw them out.

***** In South Carolina,** we knocked 2,572 doors and made 51,371 calls exposing three pro-abortion Republican senators who protected the _Life at Conception Act 's_ enemies - and they lost too.

***** In North Carolina,** 1,052 doors and 52,554 texts helped four pro-life candidates win their primaries outright.

That's just a small sample of what our door-to-door canvassing team has done over the years. The Abortion Lobby would love nothing more than for our students to stay home this fall.

Right now, we're already deployed and expanding over the next two months, where this election gets decided door by door. Our target map for the 2026 Midterms is the most ambitious we've run:

**> >> Idaho and Missouri** - ballot referendum battles where the Abortion Lobby is trying to buy a win at the ballot box.

**> >> Georgia, Iowa, Michigan, North Carolina, Ohio, Texas** - U.S. Senate races that could decide who controls the chamber.

**> >> Georgia, Iowa, Michigan, Ohio, North Carolina, Pennsylvania** - Gubernatorial and state legislative races that will shape abortion law for years.

**> >> California's 13th, Iowa's 3rd, Michigan's 10th, Pennsylvania's 10th, North Carolina's 1st, Ohio's 9th, and Texas's 34th** - U.S. House battlegrounds where a few thousand doors could flip a seat and determine control of Congress.

We'll be active in at least ten states in races up and down the ballots. And every single one of them needs boots on the ground before Tuesday, November 3rd.

Peter, the Abortion Lobby has the money, the media, and the institutions. What they don't have is thousands of young pro-lifers willing to knock on a stranger's door, get yelled at, sometimes get hit with worse than words - and go knock on the next door anyway.

That grit and determination is what wins elections.

**_[So, will you please prayerfully consider making your most generous contribution to fund our canvassers as they head into the two most important months of this election](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=57c2f7b092a845338aac9e2d3549cf46&_e=xCl87rqskzVHTI62rFK_epGFdaJFpUHnebg9PI8T5QqI5IJZSM_hn4JLOBsR4PZxO8KpBts0PcTO7f0k284yVGl2KZXOyqALEC_qdFnwExEjFnq27KOqGWDugE7b0pBajRk6s0IZ_HZBh7jVPpRI_8b0PHUKMBQ0dKdJ-Ma2YnaiJ73ovTftKiOBh2FtTpMw8z3C0oqVWplBpstIhgvDgAA8xTcQascPsizsSWstn5xdVEYGT0WRWoBYLgtjZUWUlgR3_bhCXnTS5wT5gbHzn3_eaDq7w23XRTuUEMswnXWO8xfaKtaSI6NFmmLOL8DouXfgc3UE6AFZZOX8MUvVClrhWfufFgcKlRei_YNjTsG5lZ46t-Ketz-C93n1iJq4XJc8oFEL2kIKpy4Pl_whp3U5TUIye8PH1iUKIN8meHqNhpT1qykftRhKq8bC3uzFo0WSH3NG0H-Rmt9N-dna9TQ1oSL8kEOFBguAqkkvqB-lFD331yikrfrgWd7_kdjXILaNFJ7urJL4Axy9UOLPFCT3hlpYVozlMVD0c5Yn8hrz4JqOTnxlJIV0wTehDU7MXPvaUub5RxCr28jx1jWnJas_zgBYF-vZ1hh-TtKB2vWUelIUR_12yntir4FO8SB7SBKPid_Osw32mucaeHJQxQ%3D%3D)_**?

**> >> $1,200** fully funds FIVE pro-life canvassers for an entire day in the field - roughly 400 doors knocked, one voter conversation at a time.

**> >> $240** fully funds a canvasser's entire day in the field - roughly 80 doors knocked, one voter conversation at a time.

**> >> $70** covers a canvasser's gas for a full weekend of door-knocking.

**> >> $50** puts a canvassing team through a full Church Parking Lot Blitz weekend - flyers, printing, and all.

**> >> $25** pays for a canvasser's meals for a day in the field.

Grace didn't quit after that driveway. And this fall, our students won't quit either.

But they need to know you're behind them.

Kristan Hawkins
President, Students for Life Action

P.S. - Our door-to-door pro-life canvassers will be active in at least ten states this fall, targeting races up and down the ballot. Knowing pro-lifers like you have their back will help them keep going. **_[Will you please chip in $250, $100, $50, $25, or $10 right now to keep our canvassers moving – and protected – all the way through Election Day](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=57c2f7b092a845338aac9e2d3549cf46&_e=xCl87rqskzVHTI62rFK_epGFdaJFpUHnebg9PI8T5QqI5IJZSM_hn4JLOBsR4PZxO8KpBts0PcTO7f0k284yVGl2KZXOyqALEC_qdFnwExEjFnq27KOqGWDugE7b0pBajRk6s0IZ_HZBh7jVPpRI_8b0PHUKMBQ0dKdJ-Ma2YnapmZ-IALSdHWvGmVysDljCDgSf-TpPT8uH5cQiEsjPiSoVK0uqIZ5NmDFjqAgTY7IqD9dUe-5uzfEudgKlg0tDU83g5C1_hYrwfT2Eq6KbPqC90tsD7khgvShxE_ewv-rlaZt-57yf0SYKM5t75B5ugMHtA9J0TDngx7PJw-qHvDwuyV4aM4QhvNtRcn0adpN57tohFLII9LK4s8UYd-iavrQ8y_b62NZiI7DeEIU9yWkIbqhkL-r4ftU_PcHlvZ6fqpJGQyNk7BZ8NNZEbrKjQZDb37LSh9aAfN-zk5j8VDpHqNfoJidJ2GM_VI9wVz_LY0a4QNXcxB2mOc40J7oIwSitaiGF62-nzh_V69e3y3xcBijAfAsPvopxYK-du2J7vDCMCZJrR1mhX5dilPbGkOLlMrxAu3rt6HESNkib-10CLXdagoqqAuOXsVjiI3GcZ4kRedZUrsdOoPHgzUL0)_**?

[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/54940?refcode=em20260923-61839&t=1001&akid=61839%2E1407376%2EBkS3Bs ]Demand Justice PAC[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/54940?refcode=em20260923-61839&t=1002&akid=61839%2E1407376%2EBkS3Bs ]Demand Justice PAC

Donald Trump has made his
message loud and clear: even a 6-3 conservative supermajority on the
Supreme Court — with three of his own picks on the bench — still isn’t
loyal enough.

Why? Because the moment the Court blocked his attempts to undermine

# UN General Assembly
* **Trump threatens to "annihilate" Iran: **During his speech before the UN General Assembly on Tuesday, President Donald Trump [threatened](https://substack.com/redirect/ee89165c-59fe-4358-b1fc-4eb0d01508fe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to "annihilate the Islamic republic" of Iran if the two countries fail to reach a deal.
* "Will a deal be made with Iran that lets them rebuild and create a far greater country than it ever was before, maybe one of the greatest in the Middle East or even the world?" Trump said, suggesting that Iran was waiting to see the outcome of the midterm elections. "Or do I annihilate the Islamic Republic and do it quickly, never giving them a chance to kill and destroy people and countries again?"
* Trump also defended recent U.S. moves in the Western Hemisphere, saying "to the victor belong the spoils" when he discussed the U.S.'s seizure of Venezuelan oil after U.S. forces snatched Venezuelan president Nicolas Maduro from his home in Caracas.
* He called Cuba a "failed state" that serves as a "haven for foreign adversaries to threaten America," and said its government would soon fall. These remarks prompted Cuban delegates to walk out. Cuban Foreign Minister Bruno Rodriguez Parrilla later said: "The U.S. government proves incapable of accepting that Cuba is, and has the right to be, a fully independent and sovereign country."
* Trump also attacked the International Criminal Court as a "rogue institution," called for its members to resign, and dismissed climate change as a "hoax."
* He rejected any "globalist scheme" to control advances in artificial intelligence, which he proposed be called "super intelligence," as a "test" of his influence on the world stage.
* **Iran military warns of "more crushing" attacks after Trump threats: **Iran's military warned Wednesday that it was prepared to launch "more crushing and less predictable" attacks against the U.S. and Israel after Trump threatened to "annihilate" the Islamic Republic during his UN General Assembly address Tuesday.
* Responding in a [statement](https://substack.com/redirect/22eb1b24-bfdc-4d17-b68d-9e4d42fe566f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) carried by Mehr, Iran's General Staff of the Armed Forces and the Khatam Al-Anbiya Central Command accused Trump of using the UN podium to justify U.S. "aggression" and described his threats as evidence of Washington's "strategic desperation," warning that Iranian forces were prepared to strike the U.S. and Israel with attacks more severe than those carried out earlier in the war.
* **Lula warns against foreign election interference, defends Brazil 's sovereignty**: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva [warned](https://substack.com/redirect/8a6a3ba8-7290-4d26-90b8-8be511a65bb4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Tuesday against domestic or foreign interference in Brazil's October 4 election, telling the UN General Assembly "Brazilian democracy belongs to Brazilians" and "Brazil will remain a sovereign country."
* Lula did not name Trump directly, though he did appear to reference the United States when he condemned the resurgence of "hegemonic ambitions" in the region and asserted that the country did not "need aircraft carriers in its waters," a probable reference to the U.S.'s Operation Southern Spear. "Brazil does not belong in anyone's backyard," he said, calling attempts to divide the world into spheres of influence "anachronistic."
* Lula's comments follow accusations that the Trump administration, allied with his election rival Sen. Flavio Bolsonaro, is trying to influence the vote through economic pressure, after Washington imposed two new rounds of tariffs on Brazilian goods in July.
* **Macron condemns Israeli aid restrictions in UNGA speech; UK, France, Canada talk Palestinian statehood in committee:** French President Emmanuel Macron [condemned](https://substack.com/redirect/9724e3d3-dfbb-4453-b4cd-6fca863700f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Israel's aid restrictions on Gaza as "a shame for the world" in his UN General Assembly address Tuesday, asking "what credibility do we have if we continue to remain inactive in the face of Gaza?" Macron also criticized what he characterized as Israel's "daily" violations in the occupied West Bank.
* Macron, alongside UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham, Canadian Prime Minister Mike Carney and Saudi Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan Al Saud, chaired a meeting on Palestinian statehood, where Burnham warned that failing to deliver a two-state solution "will corrode trust in the political, diplomatic, and international process."
* Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney also announced his intention to introduce restrictions on goods produced in West Bank settlements, following the UK's earlier announcement of similar restrictions.
* **U.S.-Iran UN hold first indirect talks since June MOU unraveled:** Trump administration special envoy Steve Witkoff said U.S.-Iran talks on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly were conducted through mediators who shuttled between the two delegations, clarifying that the sides did not hold direct discussions after President Donald Trump said Tuesday that three-hour talks with the Iranian delegation had been "very good."
* Iran separately said the communications took place through a Qatari mediator and that Tehran presented conditions for ending the war, including an end to U.S. "acts of aggression," a halt to the naval blockade and economic warfare, and the release of Iranian assets. Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmail Baghaei said Iran maintained its negotiating stance in the discussions. "This was not anything new," Baghaei said of Iran's conditions.
* Witkoff said, in a [post](https://substack.com/redirect/772f785d-1818-49de-abcc-678c22d476db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on X, the mediators had completed a round of discussions that he hoped would prove "constructive and promising" and would continue their work.
* **Macron says France ready for greater role in reopening Strait of Hormuz:** French President Emmanuel Macron [said](https://substack.com/redirect/f6fb6954-72ba-44bc-80a3-ea9e34f8f5ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) France was prepared to become more involved in efforts to secure transit through the Strait of Hormuz, while stressing that Paris did not want a confrontation with any country.
* Macron told ABC News that the "main objective" of his meeting with Trump was to find an agreement to reopen the vital waterway and address the global energy crisis. He reiterated France's opposition to the U.S. decision to go to war with Iran, saying "regime change by bombing a country" was not feasible and that Washington had not consulted its allies before launching the war.
* Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi met French Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly and criticized France's "interventionist" positions toward Iran and its stance on U.S. and Israeli attacks.
* **U.S., Denmark, Greenland sign deal expanding U.S. military presence** : The United States, Denmark and Greenland signed an agreement Tuesday at the UN General Assembly granting Washington expanded military access to Greenland, allowing it to modernize the Pituffik Space Base and build new facilities at Narsarsuaq and Mestersvig.
* The agreement resolves months of tension between the U.S. and Denmark, with President Donald Trump repeatedly threatening to seize the territory.
* The open-ended agreement bars non-NATO countries from establishing military installations without unanimous approval from Denmark, Greenland and the U.S., restricts investment from "sensitive sectors" outside NATO and the EU, and grants the U.S. undersea access and unrestricted overflight rights.
* **Zelenskyy says Ukraine ready for energy truce after "productive" Trump talks**: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said after a 40-minute meeting with President Donald Trump in New York at the UN that Ukraine remains ready for a bilateral "energy ceasefire" with Russia, telling reporters "we are ready" to halt strikes on Russian refineries if Moscow stops targeting Ukraine's energy system.
* Separately on Tuesday, Zelenskyy warned on Telegram that Ukrainian intelligence indicated Russia was "preparing a new massive attack" against Ukraine.
* Trump called his talks with the Ukrainian president "positive and productive" and said ending the war is likely, though a similar energy truce he announced last week collapsed almost immediately after strikes resumed.
* Zelenskyy also said he asked Trump for additional Patriot air defense missiles for winter, proposing to swap future Patriot deliveries from a German deal in exchange for supplies from U.S. stockpiles now, though Trump had not yet agreed to this arrangement.
* **U.S. withholds visa for Sudan 's Burhan, tying it to ceasefire proposal Khartoum has resisted**: The United States is [withholding](https://substack.com/redirect/566ec948-b003-421e-97d5-6acc9e883399?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a visa for Sudanese army chief Abdel Fattah al-Burhan ahead of his scheduled UN General Assembly speech, contingent on his acceptance of a 90-day ceasefire proposed by U.S. Senior Advisor Massad Boulos, Reuters reported.
* The suspension prompted Sudan's UN ambassador to appeal to Secretary-General Antonio Guterres, who said he is "deeply concerned" and engaging with the U.S. on the issue.
* **Canada pledges $71 million in Palestinian aid, imposes restrictions on Israeli settlement goods:** Canada will provide about $71 million in assistance for the Palestinian government and impose trade restrictions on goods produced in Israeli settlements, Prime Minister Mark Carney said Tuesday on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York.
* He described the restrictions on settlement products as a "pragmatic, practical" measure intended to help preserve "the possibility of a two-state solution, and ultimately a durable peace for Israelis and Palestinians."
* **Trump and Latin America allies invoke Rio Treaty against cartels:** The Trump administration is seeking to turn its campaign against Latin American cartels into a hemispheric security framework under the umbrella of the Shield of the Americas initiative. Fourteen governments joined a U.S.-backed declaration at the UN General Assembly pledging coordinated action against 24 organizations designated as "narco-terrorist".
* The declaration calls for sanctions, intelligence sharing, security cooperation and a commitment to invoke the Inter-American Treaty of Reciprocal Assistance, or Rio Treaty, to consider collective military action against the groups.

# Yemen
* **Ansarallah, Saudi-backed forces clash near Bab al-Mandab:** Ansarallah and Saudi-backed forces are fighting over the strategic area linking Taiz and Lahj governorates with Yemen's western coast near the Bab al-Mandab Strait.
* Ansarallah military spokesperson Yahya Saree said the group shot down an armed reconnaissance drone conducting "hostile missions" over Mocha in Taiz governorate.
* On the opposing side, the Saudi-backed National Shield Brigades claimed they repelled an Ansarallah offensive in the strategic Kahboub mountain range and shot down three Ansarallah drones before they could reach their positions.
* The Southern Giants Brigades, also deployed along the front, said they were continuing to target Ansarallah fortifications and reinforcements.

# Iran
* **Cargo vessel hit by projectile in Strait of Hormuz:** A cargo vessel was struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz on Wednesday, leaving the ship on fire and adrift and causing two casualties, the UK Maritime Trade Operations said.
* All crew members were evacuated from the vessel and no environmental impact was reported.
* **New U.S. sanctions on Iranian aviation take effect:** A new package of U.S. sanctions targeting Iran's aviation sector took effect Wednesday, after Washington pledged to ground Iranian airlines and penalize entities that continue doing business with them, AFP reported.
* Iran's Civil Aviation Organization said airports in Baghdad and Muscat would stop receiving Iranian flights from midnight, while negotiations were underway to reroute Baghdad-bound flights to Najaf and reach arrangements with Oman.
* Other international services, including flights to Istanbul, remained scheduled, according to Tasnim.
* Iraqi authorities have not formally announced measures, but several sources, including a senior government official, told AFP that Baghdad would comply with the U.S. restrictions.
* Separately, AFP reported that an Iranian commercial aircraft landed in China despite Washington's threat of sanctions.

# Palestine
* **Killed and wounded in Gaza:** Over the past 24 hours, three Palestinians were killed and 18 injured in Israeli attacks across Gaza, according to the Palestinian Ministry of Health.
* The total recorded death toll since October 7, 2023 has risen to 73,922 killed, with 174,995 injured. Since October 11, the first full day of the so-called ceasefire, Israel has killed at least 1,402 Palestinians in Gaza and wounded 4,881, while 834 bodies have been recovered from under the rubble.
* **Israeli attacks kill six Palestinians across Gaza since dawn:** Israeli attacks across the Gaza Strip [killed](https://substack.com/redirect/a7c8ceec-77cb-4aaf-9114-90f7b7040b2a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) six Palestinians and wounded others since dawn Wednesday, WAFA reported.
* In Gaza City, an Israeli drone strike near Al-Wafa Hospital killed one Palestinian and wounded others, while several Palestinians were wounded in a separate attack targeting a group of people near the Abu Khadra complex in the western Rimal neighborhood.
* In central Gaza, another Israeli drone strike in Deir el-Balah killed one Palestinian and wounded others.
* **Israeli forces carry out demolitions across the occupied West Bank as settlers block Salfit road:**
* **Hebron:** Israeli forces [began demolishing](https://substack.com/redirect/f09c995e-a05f-43f3-aa89-d19b85811e34?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) homes, agricultural structures, livestock pens, and water wells belonging to Palestinian families in Janba village in Masafer Yatta, south of Hebron, on Wednesday, according to WAFA.
* **Jenin:** Israeli bulldozers [demolished](https://substack.com/redirect/2b4a05d7-23e0-4056-8581-ec9bb0c6b3e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) agricultural and residential structures in the Abba village, southeast of Jenin, including four horse stables, greenhouses, sheep pens, a house under construction, a wall, and two agricultural rooms.
* **Salfit:** Israeli settlers [blocked](https://substack.com/redirect/1440ea7d-9fff-421c-a826-3b3dd6457292?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Wadi Al-Shaer road connecting Salfit city with Al-Lubban Al-Sharqiya by placing rocks and metal spikes on the road, damaging several vehicles before Palestinians removed the obstacles and reopened it. Israeli forces also reclosed the northern entrance to Salfit city.
* **East Jerusalem:** Israeli authorities [demolished](https://substack.com/redirect/de78d436-739a-44a3-98d5-2e6c76f7a095?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) sheet-metal industrial structures belonging to Palestinians in Jaba, northeast of Jerusalem, and bulldozed the surrounding land.
* **Military court extends detention of Palestinian-American journalist:** A military court on Wednesday extended the detention of Palestinian-American journalist and Drop Site contributor Naqaa Hamed until September 28, according to her lawyer, Khaled Mahajneh.
* Hamed was [arrested](https://substack.com/redirect/16572641-2b73-40f7-a26b-57070f9cce2a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by Israeli forces on September 15 as she was returning from a reporting assignment in the occupied West Bank. Israeli authorities have accused her of incitement against Israeli settlers and the army, communicating with the enemy, and cooperating with the enemy. She is currently being held in Damon Prison in northern Israel.
* Mahajneh previously told Drop Site "the whole case is related to her journalistic work" and that her arrest came solely because of a campaign targeting her by Israeli settlers.
* Hamed is a freelance journalist who has worked for various international outlets, including Drop Site News. Maryland Sen. Chris Van Hollen, Michigan Rep. Rashida Tlaib, and other U.S. officials, as well as the Committee to Protect Journalists, have called for her release.

# U.S. News
* **DoorDash settles NYC underpayment probe for $131.5 million** : DoorDash [reached](https://substack.com/redirect/1f52cc45-a534-4172-aad5-ac6fa4732f63?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a record $131.5 million settlement with New York City's Department of Consumer and Worker Protection Tuesday over findings that the company underpaid or delayed payments to delivery workers, paying the City $16.7 million in fines and giving nearly $115 million in relief to about 264,000 "Dashers," who received a median payout of roughly $48.
* DoorDash said in a statement, "Simply put, we screwed up... Our mistakes meant some Dashers were underpaid or paid late."
* The deal is the largest worker settlement in New York City history and the largest settlement involving food delivery workers in the United States. It comes nearly eight months after the city agency accused DoorDash and Uber Eats of using "design tricks" to deprive workers of more than $550 million in tips.
* **Federal judge orders Texas to air condition all prisons by end of 2029:** U.S. District Judge**Robert Pitman** [ordered](https://substack.com/redirect/b680d15a-3233-4ff7-ac2c-ab248e39c612?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Texas to develop and implement a plan to install air conditioning across all 104 of its prison facilities by Dec. 31, 2029, ruling Tuesday that lockups without cooling violate the Eighth Amendment and that the Texas Department of Criminal Justice's response to extreme heat constitutes "deliberate indifference."
* Just over a third of Texas correctional facilities were fully air conditioned as of Sept. 1, and Pitman noted the agency's recent $289 million legislative funding request for air conditioning fell well short of what it told the court it could obtain from state lawmakers. Installing air conditioning could cost up to $1.5 billion, the agency has noted.
* Inmate advocates have attributed at least 10 heat-related deaths to lack of air conditioning between 2022 and 2025.
* **ShinyHunters hackers claim to have breached FBI, stolen data on all employees:** Hacking group **ShinyHunters** [claimed](https://substack.com/redirect/d528e7cd-f29f-43ec-8fa8-83adb1694750?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Tuesday to have breached multiple FBI-related services and stolen data "on all FBI employees and applicants," including names, home addresses, phone numbers and spouse information, according to 404 Media.
* The group also defaced the FBI's jobs website Tuesday with a message reading "this site has been seized by ShinyHunters."
* A group representative provided a sample containing data on 5,000 FBI employees, some of which 404 Media verified through open-source tools, and said the group used a zero-day exploit in an Oracle PeopleSoft product to access AWS GovCloud servers and exfiltrate between two and three terabytes of data.
* An FBI spokesperson said the agency is "aware of claims" and investigating the incident.
* The group, which typically extorts victims after breaches, said its motivation here is not financial but rather "coercion" tied to a prior FBI report describing ShinyHunters' tactics, which it demanded be corrected or removed within a week.
* **Trump administration asks Supreme Court to overturn release of pro-Palestinian scholar** : The Trump administration [petitioned](https://substack.com/redirect/a2f5e6bd-8af9-4753-a6e6-c1c037ba6078?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the Supreme Court Monday to overturn a lower court's release of Georgetown scholar **Badar Khan Suri** , an Indian citizen and postdoctoral fellow arrested by masked ICE officers in March 2025 amid a broader crackdown on pro-Palestinian activism on college campuses, after a district court judge freed him in May 2025 on grounds he was likely to succeed in proving his arrest was retaliation for constitutionally protected speech.
* Solicitor General **D. John Sauer** argued the 4th Circuit's July 2-1 ruling upholding Suri's release--which found lower courts could hear constitutional detention challenges even amid pending immigration proceedings--threatens nationwide immigration enforcement by letting detainees "bypass immigration courts."
* **Trump backs diesel export ban amid GOP pressure over record fuel prices** : President Donald Trump [said](https://substack.com/redirect/947604aa-db57-467d-b487-6970c18ed705?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Tuesday he has called for a ban on U.S. diesel exports, with Treasury Secretary **Scott Bessent** confirming the administration is examining whether a full or partial ban is feasible.
* The administration had previously resisted calls for a diesel export ban, which had come from farmers and truckers squeezed by fuel price increases. Iowa Republicans Sen. **Chuck Grassley** and Rep. **Ashley Hinson** made public calls for the policy earlier this week, and Senate Majority Leader **John Thune** said last week he was "open" to the idea.
* **Trump officials plan to allow up to 17,500 more White Afrikaner refugees over next year** : The Trump administration [notified](https://substack.com/redirect/5474eba7-4cdd-41a3-9ec4-ed0b24e0e3bc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Congress Tuesday it plans to allocate up to 17,500 refugee spots for fiscal year 2027, "primarily" for White Afrikaners from South Africa, according to a notice obtained by CBS News.

* **Trump officials cut 760,000 from ACA over alleged fraud:** Vice President **JD Vance** and administration officials [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/e6014498-5ed5-472b-a3f9-de50c95e1024?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Tuesday they are removing about 760,000 people from Affordable Care Act coverage over suspected fraud, with an additional 419,000 enrollees facing further verification.

* Officials claimed the removals would save $2.2 billion in federal spending.
* The crackdown comes as ACA enrollment, which peaked under President **Joe Biden** , has already fallen by more than 1 million since Trump took office.

John Curtis calls for Senate probe of Donald Trump Jr. over Russian oligarch 's wedding gift: **Sen. **John Curtis** (R-Utah) [sent](https://substack.com/redirect/e3f7cc88-ec1f-421c-b2ae-1783fa6f2790?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a letter to Senate Judiciary Committee leaders Chuck Grassley and **Dick Durbin** calling for an investigation into "the use of presidential family relationships for private financial benefit" urging subpoenas for **Donald Trump Jr.** after ProPublica reported that Russian businessman **Umar Kremlev** , who has close ties to Vladimir Putin, paid for a lavish Bahamas wedding afterparty for Trump Jr.

* **El-Sayed defends Harris support:** After campaigning alongside former Vice President **Kamala Harris** , in Detroit, Michigan, Democratic Senate nominee **Abdul El-Sayed** [defended](https://substack.com/redirect/2cdcbeff-1d24-443c-9169-292ab80001b4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) her support, with particular attention to the controversy surrounding her role in the Biden administration's conduct during Israel's genocide in Gaza and El-Sayed's support for the "Uncommitted" movement in Michigan.

* **Byron Donalds scrubs Trump references from campaign website amid president 's sinking approval**: Florida gubernatorial candidate **Byron Donalds**[ removed](https://substack.com/redirect/03c59735-b3ff-4def-9bda-de0a072d5be8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at least eight prominent references to President Donald Trump's endorsement from his campaign website, including a homepage banner, a "Chip in" button, and a photo of Donalds with the president, according to the Miami Herald.
